overview.description: The Pictet Emerging Markets Rising Economies ETF (RISE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is actively managed and invests in emerging markets equities selected through a value-oriented approach. The strategy focuses on countries with growing working-age populations and companies viewed as undervalued with improving prospects RISE was launched on Apr 22, 2026 and is issued by Pictet.
